Six promises behind every deal

100% verified listings

Every title deed, building permit and developer licence is checked against Ejar and REGA records before a home reaches you.

Off-market access

Around a third of our sales never appear online — private releases from developers and families who trust our discretion.

Investment intelligence

Yield forecasts, rental comparables and Vision 2030 pipeline data for every property, so decisions rest on numbers.

Financing made simple

Sharia-compliant mortgages arranged with leading Saudi banks, including options for eligible non-residents.

Legal & handover

REGA-compliant contracts, escrow-protected payments, snagging inspections and utility setup — all handled.

After-sale care

Property management, leasing and resale support, so your home keeps performing long after the keys change hands.

Our flagship lounge

King Fahd Road, Riyadh — private viewings by appointment, seven days a week.
